scope: Pass 1 source quality only; no candidate authoring.

method.metadata: All 125 records across 9 source maps reviewed for identity, author, kind, tier, URL, trust reason, independence, access and read depth.
method.web: Risk-weighted primary-page sample opened through search_service_web_run. No images inspected at pixel level; no videos watched. Failed opens remain failed.
method.rule: Evidence eligibility is claim/access scoped. Outlines, snippets, product pages, synopses and unwatched videos support only the public content actually read. Independence is based on teacher/author or institution lineage, never agent count or duplicate rows.

actions.finding: Tier B is misapplied to written/non-video records.
actions.action: Move a named, verified professional writer to A only where qualification supports it; otherwise use an unranked written lead/editorial designation. Do not count secondary video summaries as watched video.

actions.finding: Exact page duplicates must be deduplicated.
actions.action: Use 122 unique pages from 125 records; retain cross-scope links but one bibliographic identity per exact URL.

actions.finding: Course outlines, indexes, event descriptions and video landing pages are not the lesson.
actions.action: Scope claims strictly to public text. Do not extract unseen lesson controls/examples/acceptance; access requires a lawful actual read/watch.

actions.finding: Event rules and sword museum material are not photography skill instruction.
actions.action: Use only for venue constraints or sword-domain context.

actions.finding: Film/cinematography sources are adjacent transfer, not direct still portrait evidence.
actions.action: Require explicit adaptation plus still portrait source corroboration before formal core claims.

actions.finding: Unbylined editorial, conflicting byline, or generic identity boilerplate needs qualification cleanup.
actions.action: Replace generic identity placeholders with the actual named institution/person supported by the primary page. Attribute institutional pages to the institution; resolve Carlino/Jones display conflict before teacher-specific claims.

actions.finding: Access/byline metadata corrections from re-opened pages.
actions.action: See `recommended_access`; these are page/synopsis access corrections only, never proof that paid lessons/videos were accessed.

actions.finding: No Tier C visual discovery records are present.
actions.action: Report C=0; do not force articles into C.
